newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: port conditions update - Bangladesh - lloyds.
newsitem.headline: port conditions update - Bangladesh - lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, July 30 - Chittagong - The Sramik Karmachary Oikya Parishad, comprised mainly of mill and factory workers, has called a 24-hour nation-wide strike with effect from 0600, July 30. As a result, stuffing and delivery of cargo from port transit sheds is not taking place. However, loading/unloading of cargo from vessels is not reported to be affected.
